before.arch:
MTOP is Moral Topology, a standalone application in the Social Tools family.
Canonical package: _application/moral_topology, a local Dash application. space.py
defines four illustrative axes; levers.py defines 25 conditions and five traits;
forces.py and dynamics.py own the headless numerical mechanism; scenarios.py holds
21 authored cases; comparison.py creates reproducible paired interventions;
figures.py, guided.py and app.py render the guided and full-model workspaces.
Assets are local. The runtime has no database or trading dependency. The shared
cross-op register is project coordination only. _source is immutable input.
The project stays in its current folder and owns an independent local Git repository.
before.core:
A consumer-facing decision-mapping studio: make the assumptions behind a
judgement discussable. Choose a situation, change one condition and read how its
modeled configuration shifts across scope, binding, processing and foundation tilt.
Mechanism inspection and accessibility are the purpose; the historical cases are
retained as illustrations. Numerical values are authored assumptions, not fitted
sociological measurements or moral verdicts. Guided comparisons and the independent
full-model sandbox serve first-use explanation and deeper exploration respectively.
Future direction is comprehension testing before expanding authoring or sharing.
